subject: Security control platform selection + contract timeline
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.inference.com>
To: Ellie Brown <ebrown@drata.com>, Marco Ruiz <mruiz@trustcenter.com>, Sanjay Patel <sanjay@vanta.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.inference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Security control platform selection + contract timeline

Team —

Thanks for taking the time so far on the Acme Health evaluation. We're in the final selection window and need the following from each vendor by end of day Monday (Nov 15):

- Final commercial proposal (price tiers, seat counts/agents, and any committed-usage discounts)
- SOW / onboarding timeline with milestones (integration, evidence collection, SOC mapping)
- Confirmation of SSO + SAML support and KMS/HSM options
- Any standard contract terms you expect us to accept / must-redline items

I've attached our selection criteria workbook (selection-criteria.xlsx) with the weighted checklist we're using. High level preferences from Acme: automated evidence capture, minimal engineering lift for agents, and strict log/audit retention controls.

Neha/Marcus — once you have vendor responses, can you create a one-page procurement summary for procurement/legal with the recommended vendor and the rationale? Laura — any procurement timeline constraints we should surface to the vendors?

Appreciate quick turn here — we want vendor selection by Wed 11/17 and contract executed by 11/30 if possible.

Thanks,
Evelyn Hart
Head of Product Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: selection-criteria.xlsx (spreadsheet, 36KB)

From: Ellie Brown <ebrown@drata.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.inference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 14:03:12 -0800
Subject: Re: Security control platform selection + contract timeline

Hi Evelyn —

Thanks for the clear list. Attached is our proposal (Drata-proposal-Nov2026.pdf). Quick highlights:

- Pricing: $18,000/mo for the baseline package (up to 100 assets), $25k/mo for full infra + app coverage. Annual commit discounts available (12% for 12-month).
- Onboarding: 4–6 weeks typical for teams with automated connectors (SSO, AWS, GCP, GitHub).
- Controls: SOC2 mapping, continuous monitoring, automated evidence collection (connectors + light-weight agent).
- Security: KMS integration supported via customer-managed keys; we provide SOC2 report and can coordinate evidence exports for auditors.

I've also attached a proposed SOW and a condensed technical appendix. We can schedule a 30-minute call tomorrow to walk through redlines.

Regards,
Ellie Brown
Enterprise Solutions Lead, Drata
Drata, Inc.

Attachments: Drata-proposal-Nov2026.pdf (PDF, 210KB)

Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 16:28:45 -0800
Subject: Re: Security control platform selection + contract timeline

Evelyn —

Appreciate the timeframe. Attached is TrustCenter's proposal (trustcenter-proposal-20261112.pdf). High-level notes:

- Pricing: modular pricing; base platform $12k/mo + connectors add-on.
- Differentiators: deeper compliance workflow customization, native TrustCenter evidence hub that integrates with third-party ticketing.
- Onboarding: 6–8 weeks for full automation; shorter pilots available.
- Integrations: we have a Redwood Console integration path we can enable (webhooks + API).

Happy to do a demo/sync next week.

Best,
Marco Ruiz
Partnerships, TrustCenter

Attachments: trustcenter-proposal-20261112.pdf (PDF, 180KB)

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.inference.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.inference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 11:02:09 -0800
Subject: Re: Security control platform selection + contract timeline

Marcus / Neha —

Quick read-through of the two proposals. My initial take:

- Drata (Ellie): better automated evidence coverage, clearer SOW, slightly higher cost but lower expected engineering lift.
- TrustCenter (Marco): cheaper base price and stronger workflow customization — good if Acme wants to build bespoke processes.

Key procurement asks before I recommend:
- Karthik: confirm the work required for KMS integration and whether any telemetry raises PII concerns.
- Marcus: tally expected engineering hours for connector work and quick cost estimate.
- Laura: can procurement/legal accept Drata's standard indemnity clause or do we need to negotiate service-level indemnities?

I'll prioritize Drata if security gives the green light on KMS + logs. If we can lock a 6-week onboarding and a firm SOW, I think the faster time-to-evidence is worth the premium.

Evelyn

Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Sat, 14 Nov 2026 09:30:22 -0800
Subject: Re: Security control platform selection + contract timeline

Evelyn / team —

Attached is a short gap assessment (security-gap-assessment.pdf) after skimming both proposals. Two items to flag:

1) KMS/HSM: both vendors support customer-managed keys but Drata's approach requires a one-time engineering handoff for key rotation automation. Estimate: ~2 engineer-weeks to verify and automate key rotation across connectors.

2) Audit logs & retention: vendor default retention is 1 year; Acme requires 3 years for a subset of logs. Need contract language to guarantee retention or an export facility.

Also, Drata's evidence exports are granular which simplifies audit requests, while TrustCenter will need a small custom mapping for some of our infra controls.

Recommend: proceed with Drata conditional on contract language around retention and confirmation of the KMS handoff timeline. I'll draft a short security addendum we can attach to the SOW.

-- Karthik
Principal Security Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachments: security-gap-assessment.pdf (PDF, 48KB)

From: Ellie Brown <ebrown@drata.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.inference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.inference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Nov 2026 16:47:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Security control platform selection + contract timeline

Evelyn —

Thanks for the feedback and Karthik's assessment. I've attached a revised SOW that includes:

- A KMS handoff milestone with estimated engineering time (we've committed to 2 weeks of technical onboarding support).
- A data retention clause offering 3-year archival for audited logs (via export or managed retention).
- Clarified indemnity language for SOC-related audit findings (per your request).

Attached: Drata-SOW-revised-Nov15.docx. If that looks good, I've also pushed a DocuSign envelope for the SOW + MSA so you can route to legal/procurement: https://app.docusign.com/embeddedSigning/session/XYZ-Drata-SOW

Proposed next steps:
- EOD Tue 11/16: procurement/legal to review SOW and flag any redlines
- Wed 11/17: exec approval for vendor selection
- Target contract signature window: 11/23–11/30 with onboarding kickoff the week of 11/30

Happy to join a call if you want to walk through the redlines in real time.

Regards,
Ellie Brown
Enterprise Solutions Lead, Drata

Attachments: Drata-SOW-revised-Nov15.docx (DOCX, 76KB)
